simple.meaning: מְנֵא (mᵉnêʼ) is a Hebrew word meaning “numbered.” BibleIQ connects the English word back to this source word so its use can be compared across Scripture.
simple.biblicalBackground: מְנֵא (H4484) appears 3 times in the Hebrew Bible, beginning at Daniel 5:25, with occurrences in Daniel.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מְנֵא (H4484) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: English translations can use the same English word for different Hebrew words. BibleIQ anchors the study in מְנֵא (H4484) before moving outward to related references.
simple.summary: מְנֵא (mᵉnêʼ) / H4484 is traced through Daniel 5:25, Daniel 5:26 using source-language evidence and occurrence comparison.

definitions.full: H4484. mene מְנֵא noun [masculine] maneh, mina , a weight (see Biblical Hebrew; Old Aramaic מנה SAC 75 Lzb 313 ); — absolute Dan 5:25 (twice in verse); 5:26 , see ClGann :JAs Juillet-Août, 1886, 36 ff. Nö ZA i. 414 f. Dr and others; its connection in Daniel with מְנָה is due to word-play; see also תְּקֵל מְּרֵס, .
